ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: available 100% of the time, including during maintenance windows and infrastructure upgrades
evidence_from_requirement: The requirement states: 'The payment service shall be available 100% of the time, including during maintenance windows and infrastructure upgrades.'
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The phrase 'including during maintenance windows' explicitly extends the scope of the '100% of the time' claim to cover those specific periods. The second interpretation (that the 100% metric does not apply to maintenance windows) contradicts the explicit inclusion clause in the text. Therefore, only the first interpretation—that the service must be operational 100% of the time, even during maintenance—is supported by the requirement text. The ambiguity is a false positive.
